# OpenChamber

OpenChamber is an open-source workspace for running and supervising OpenCode agents from 
    * a browser 
    * or an installable PWA 
    * or a desktop version.

OpenChamber installs its own opencode binary tool and use the standard opencode config file location.
Using command `./aistack och connect aistack` 
    * OpenChamber will use opencode binary from AIStack. 
    * It will load openchamber context file generated by AIStack, so when OpenChamber launch a shell, it will use AIStack tools and runtimes.

OpenChamber VS Code extension - https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=FedaykinDev.openchamber
    * it does not download OpenCode and needs OpenCode in PATH to launch opencode in server session (`opencode serve --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port ...`)

## NOTES

- OpenChamber installs its own opencode binary tool and use the standard opencode config file location
- OpenChamber uses the login shell, adds the OpenCode binary to `PATH`, and requires a full restart after any environment or `PATH` changes.
- `OPENCODE_BINARY` allow to specify opencode binary and takes precedence over the default bundled binary, but the `settings.opencodeBinary` setting can override it.
- OpenChamber resolution order for OpenCode is
  1. [ONLY VSCODE EXTENSION] VS Code settings openchamber.opencodeBinary
  2. OpenChamber settings.opencodeBinary
  3. env var : OPENCODE_BINARY, OPENCODE_PATH, OPENCHAMBER_OPENCODE_PATH, OPENCHAMBER_OPENCODE_BIN.
  4. [NOT FOR VSCODE EXTENSION] embedded OpenCode
  5. automatic detection from PATH.
- MacOS: When launched from Finder, OpenChamber initially receives the minimal macOS `PATH`: `/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin`. It then starts `/bin/zsh` as an interactive login shell and merges the resulting environment.
